brief:
Hundreds of thousands of Palestinians in Gaza have been repeatedly displaced by years of bombardment, forcing them to seek shelter in increasingly constrained areas, Dawn reported. Israeli control of large portions of the Strip has narrowed available space for civilians, trapping many families amid widespread destruction. As of August 2026, around 82% of structures in Gaza had sustained damage.

With winter approaching, families sheltering in damaged buildings and fragile tents face acute vulnerability. The combination of physical destruction, territorial restrictions, and limited displacement options has created a humanitarian crisis as seasonal weather threatens already precarious living conditions.
dek: Years of bombardment and repeated displacement have forced hundreds of thousands of Palestinians to move and seek shelter elsewhere, often multiple times. With Israel controlling large areas of the Strip and the space available for people in Gaza increasingly limited, many families have found themselves trapped in narrow areas amid destruction affecting around 82% of structures, as of August 2026.
title: Bombardment leaves Gaza's displaced facing winter in damaged shelters
